content: Pole amatole o musyengi Korinte
Va djulu vane, Pole akeghusughe musyengi Atene mu wende o musyengi Korinte.

Akebengunu na muSwife dine dyandi Akilase, mwise Pon. Amabe na mughatsi andi Pirisile. Djowu mbé basekatsinge nobotughe o bulongu bu Yitali, mumbari kaghe Kolode amaveghe dirume ombu baSwife botsu bakedusughe musyengi Rome. Pole amasobene nowu,
mumbari avu na yisalu yimosi nowu, bamarungaange masambe. Adine Pole amatsanine nowu, lake bakesalaange va mosi.
Kale yilumbu yuvume yi baSwife, Pole amalonzaange o ndaghu dusambu, na djandi amarombaange udute baSwife viri viri baNgereke ombu Fumu.

Ave Silase na Timote bamadusuyile o yinange yi Masedwane mu tole o Korinte, Pole akesingene yike na yisalu yusamunaange Musamu Wuboti wu Nzambi. Djandi akevindighaange va wusu baSwife yiri Djesu adji Kirisete.

Tumbe baSwife bamabuse musamu awu Pole, amabasamuninaange na bamamusyenge. Kaboghu Pole amakuke difufundu di bikutu byandi na amabatsingule yi: «Malungu menu mabi mu myuru myenu! Menu nyisyeme. Mudjonge enu bakole. Ubandile na nyangu, nyuwende ombu djowu abagha baSwife.»
Akebotughe vane na akewende ombu dibaale dine dyandi Tityuse Susutuse, amayitsaange Nzambi. Ndaghu wandi djimabe va mughule ndaghu dusambu dji baSwife.
Kirisepuse yivunde yi ndaghu dusambu, akevayile yitu ombu Fumu, na mukute andi wotsu. Batu bapwele bise Korinte, bamawululu Pole. Bakevayile yitu yowu mu Nzambi na bakebatusu.
Mukolu mosi, Pole akedile dulasu, mune Fumu emutsinguli didi: «Wuyala ghome. Tumbe bwela uvose, wuyavole:
nyidji naghu. Vagha mutu oghudimbise vo oghukambise, mumbari bapwele bavu bami mu musyengi ewuwu.»
Pole aketsane yilime yimosi na yibuku o Korinte, amalonzaange ombu botsu musamu Nzambi.
Mu temu adji Ghalyone amabilaange yivunde yi musyengi Rome mu yinange yi Akaye, baSwife bamawulusunu mu ufwengilile Pole. Bakemubeghe o ndaghu bunzonzi.
Baketubule yi: «Dibaale dyédidi erondi utsotse batu mu yitsaange Nzambi mu duvyakusunu du mughaghe etu.»
Pole mbé aronde uvose, ave Ghalyone amawaghulili baSwife: «Djenu baSwife, mbé yi mutu atsiboke vo dyambu dibi atsivaghe, mbé nubo temu djuduwulu, notabule bunzonzi.
Tumbe dibila yiri, mutsundu mu dyambu di bighume, mine, vo di mughaghe djenubeni, dyoni didutsuni. Nyibusi ube nzonzi dji mambu nane!»
Na akebapalise.
Kaboghu, botsu bakeghange Sosetene, yivunde yi ndaghu dusambu, na bakemudimbe va mune ndaghu mighaghe. Tumbe Ghalyone asamadilabe yi dyambu.
Pole eghabuyi o musyengi Antyose dji Siri

Pole akesyale mu yitsingu o Korinte. Akekakene na baane ba ngudji, akenangeme mu watange djone Pirisile na Akilase na bakewende o Siri. Ne akebotughe musyengi, mu disabu di Senkire, amafughe muru, mumbari amava pangini ombu Nzambi.
Banotole o musyengi Yifese, Pole akesile Pirsile na Akilase. Akewende o ndaghu dusambu na akevose na baSwife.
Djowu bakemuwivule usyale yitsingu, tumbe asamasinge.
Akebasile novose: «Nughabughe ombu wenu, pa Nzambi atsisinge.» Akenangeme mu watange mu botughe Yifese, na akewende.
Anotole o musyengi Sesaré, akelewé o Serusaleme musimbe dibundu, mba akewende o Antyose.
Akevyose mwa pesu temu o Antyose, mba akewende. Aketabe yinange yi Ghalasi na Firisi, mu warise yitu yi badukitsi botsu.
Apolose elonzi batu o Yifese na o Korinte
Mu temu édjine, vamabe muSwife dine dyandi Apolose, mwise Alesanderi, aketole o Yifese. Amabe dibaale dimavosaange na buketi, amadjabaange burange Bisonu bi Nzambi.
Amalongu mu dyambu di Nzile Fumu, amatubulaange nolonze na yusile yotsu mu dyambu di Djesu. Amalonzu yike musamu dubatusu du San.
Amavose na ngenze djotsu o ndaghu dusambu. Banomane umuwulu, Pirisile na Akilase bakemubonge mu mutsingule kengili Nzile Nzambi.

Va djulu vane, Apolose amaronde uwende o Akaye. Baane ba ngudji bandi ba babaale na baghetu bakemuwarise mu dwendu dweni. Bakerende mughande ombu badukitsi ba yinange yéyine, yiri bakemudile ndilulu djiboti. Na etoli, amawamuse pwele, abamasinge Fumu, bakela ubwedji mu yese yi Nzambi.
Amavovene na baSwife mu ubuse mambu mowu va wusu batu botsu. Mu Bisonu bi Nzambi, amabalase yiri Djesu adji Kirisete.
